name: Teensy 4.0
note: PJRC Teensy 4.0 at vendor tier for the TANG R5 wiring (M08-T13). Frame: USB end at +y, top view, origin at the centre of the 2 x 14 pin array. n counts the left column from the USB end, then the right column; PJRC numbers the pins by name only. The five end pads (On/Off, Program, GND, 3.3V, VBat) and the bottom pads are left out: the drawing gives no pitch for the end pads. The board outline is drawn centred on the pin array, which the drawing does not dimension (inferred, drawing only).
